## Change and mathematical scope

PR942's T37 construction leaves six rank-one idle dimensions. This changes one of its 333 U8 calls by reversing a four-helper entrance-promotion group and places the four enlarged helpers into four of those gaps. The resulting conditional exponent is **κ = 0.001661961039655941**, an increase of **0.000000000491941994** over the selected PR942 value, 0.001661960547713947.

The change keeps the scalar word and endpoints fixed. Four helper widths increase from four to five; four whole-helper exchanges and the associated offset updates consume four idle dimensions. The exact global profile becomes:

```text
{1:848478, 2:112562, 3:148522, 4:53942, 5:23976, 8:2664, 48:11086}
```

There are 33,152 live families, 33,666 physical families, rank mass 2,408,256 and deficit 11,840. The complex root is certified between the adjacent rational endpoints `0.001664727752321934979327` and `0.001664727752321934979328`. The outer reduction charges the full 1024-bit complex allowance and gives the exact nominated κ, `1661961039655941/10^18`.

The package contains the literal local edits, all 20 changed owner records, a deterministic reconstruction, a written dependency argument, pinned sources, strict assembly and separate arithmetic certificates. [The research note](https://github.com/davidNbreslauer/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c1504cd75aae9b255ba16bf8e28d3f38af34c14/research/u8-e4-gap-fill/README.md) explains the construction and proof obligations. Changing a local supplier's width inventory changes a hypothesis of PR942's homogeneous U8 ceiling.

The tested base is `407d52ff15b2217b6e22bce44728b4c3907b6515`. Before submission, upstream `abdc6a70` still selects PR942 and has no changes to this package's pinned source files. This adds only `research/u8-e4-gap-fill/`; the selected record and `upstream/` remain unchanged. Larger concurrent claims, including #987, #1004, #1005, #1018 and their later T16 descendants, are acknowledged. This contribution is the separate entrance-frame and gap-filling mechanism on the fully replayed T37 baseline; it makes no largest-pending-κ claim.

## Validation

The complete local finite replay passed on macOS arm64 with Python 3.12. A fresh cold PR942 ancestry replay passed first; the candidate verifier then revalidated that complete evidence closure before reuse. [VALIDATION.json](https://github.com/davidNbreslauer/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c1504cd75aae9b255ba16bf8e28d3f38af34c14/research/u8-e4-gap-fill/VALIDATION.json) records the environment, receipts, hashes and limits.

- Native endpoint, scalar, frame, wrapper and phase checks passed, including 25 negative controls and 2,949 phase edges.
- The separate event/owner/chart recount checked all 167,832 helper roles, 333 calls and 9,628 actual chart types. It rejected eight owner mutations and omission of each of the 20 owner edits.
- Emitted controller audit, complete invoice, all nine finite-admission checks and all 47 strict outer inequalities passed. Required prefix: 779 bits against a 1024-bit allowance. Physical row coefficient: 17,495 against the retained limit of 20,161.
- All 23 controller mutations, 114 strict admission mutations, 12 bit-supplier controls, seven payload boundaries and 11 payload mutations passed. The two-provider control counts are derived from the pinned generator and actual dispatch; verifier predicates are unchanged.
- Mercator, base-two and separate positive-binomial arithmetic agreed. Final binding rechecked 122 generated artifacts. The selected-source inventory and whitespace checks passed.

Cold reproduction, from the repository root with a new output directory:

```sh
python3 -B research/u8-e4-gap-fill/verify.py --work /absolute/path/to/new-e4-replay
```

The research note also documents reuse of a completed, source-bound `verify_frontier942.py` output. Assertions must remain enabled. Repository-wide `make verify`, hosted CI, independent human review and a full proof-assistant formalization are not claimed.

The inherited all-size/compiler, common-label and mutable-source realization, physical hosting, precision/tape, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 assumptions remain open. Finite certificate success does not establish the full multiplication theorem.

Credit: BlockInvert's PR664-style `p6n-k4` entrance promotions; Jeremy Kothe's PR799 and PR869/870 U8 lineage; Jonathan Capalbo's PR942 owners and 1024-bit integration; Chafik Boukhalfa's PR685/890 and Hao Yan's PR858 owner lineage; and the native, bit, arithmetic and outer suppliers retained in the linked notices. Prepared for David Breslauer with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The new material is Apache-2.0; retained source licenses and notices remain in force.
